subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should #80450 remain the canonical design thread for explicit detached-longwork final-summary ownership, and which existing substrate should own the durable delivery obligation?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested contract, but the remaining work defines model-facing, plugin-facing, persisted-state, and channel-delivery semantics rather than a narrow mechanical fix.

options.title: Keep #80450 canonical and define a narrow owner contract
options.body: Maintain this issue as the decision thread, choose the owner-mode/default semantics, and recut the implementation into focused PRs with docs and live proof.

options.title: Fold into a broader durable delivery substrate
options.body: Move the invariant into an existing pending-final/outbox-style delivery substrate if maintainers want confirmation, retry, and suppression ownership solved together.

options.title: Split or close as not planned
options.body: Close this thread only if maintainers decide explicit final-summary ownership should not be a core/runtime contract or should be tracked by a narrower existing issue.

recommendation.title: Keep #80450 canonical and define a narrow owner contract
recommendation.body: Maintain this issue as the decision thread, choose the owner-mode/default semantics, and recut the implementation into focused PRs with docs and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete appears in recent and historical adjacent routing/plugin-subagent work and is the best available owner for a cross-cutting API/product decision.
